mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, enabled) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: select r.role_code from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleCode}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_code) DO NOTHING
